EXT.evidence: Hedges and delays bringing up the topic (“not so much a question as more of a general wondering”; has “for a while now been wanting to say something” and is only now beginning), indicating reservation.

AGR.evidence: Polite framing (“I have a question”) but no clear signs of generosity or uncooperativeness; not enough to judge straightforwardness strongly.

CON.evidence: No concrete actions showing organization or carelessness; conversational hesitation doesn’t clearly reflect conscientiousness.

NEU.evidence: Hesitates for a while to say something and reacts with “What? Ow!”, suggesting nervousness/sensitivity in the moment.

OPN.evidence: Expresses curiosity by framing the topic as a “general wondering,” indicating openness to ideas.
